meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把只读看板工具 clidash 拷进 tools/clidash 并生成配置文件，让你在本地 127.0.0.1:4690 看到每个 ncl 资源一个标签页的表格，外加 Agents 概览、消息活动、日志和文件查看面板。
howto.when: 当你要求添加 clidash 看板，或想给能以 JSON 列出资源的 CLI（如 ncl、docker、kubectl 等）搭一个只读网页界面时触发。

say.text: 把 clidash 装上，配好 ncl 的配置
say.note: 拷贝工具目录并生成 clidash.config.json

say.text: 跑一下 npm test 确认测试都过
say.note: 测试用桩 CLI，不需要真实 ncl

say.text: 启动 server.js，然后 curl 检查 /api/clis
say.note: 确认 ncl 资源发现成功

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude copies the read-only clidash dashboard into tools/clidash, writes its config, and serves it at 127.0.0.1:4690 — one tab and table per ncl resource, plus Agents overview, activity, logs and a file viewer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add clidash, or want a read-only dashboard for any CLI that lists resources as JSON (ncl, docker, kubectl, etc.).

say_en.text: Install clidash and set up the ncl config
say_en.note: Copies the tool dir and writes clidash.config.json

say_en.text: Run npm test to confirm the tests pass
say_en.note: Tests use a stub CLI, no real ncl needed

say_en.text: Start server.js and curl /api/clis to check
